summary: Add an attachment and show what was chosen.
corePrinciple: Keep empty, preview, and unavailable states distinct.

anatomy.title: Empty and preview reveal different parts
anatomy.description: The 44 × 44 cell keeps the add icon, thumbnail, and optional remove affordance within one fixed boundary.
blocks: The fixed boundary is the target and visual container.

configuration.title: Supply state, image, and picker behavior explicitly
configuration.description: Empty can call onPress or an injected picker. Preview needs an image source; onRemove is optional.
blocks: Use picker with onAssetsPicked, or wire a platform-specific onPress.
Supply preview plus imageSource to show what was chosen.
Omit onRemove when the selected attachment cannot be cleared here.

states.title: Keep empty, preview, and unavailable distinct
states.description: These are visibly different outcomes. Unavailable uses the public isDisabled behavior rather than a new visual variant.
blocks: The add icon tells people the cell can accept an attachment.
A thumbnail confirms the chosen asset and can expose removal.
The cell is dimmed and its press behavior is disabled.

sizing.title: The cell stays 44 × 44
sizing.description: Additem owns its fixed cell. A FormUpload or another public layout owns row gaps, wrapping, and the surrounding label.
blocks: Cells keep the same footprint while the row controls spacing.
The host can wrap around the fixed cell without resizing it.

content.title: Name the attachment beside the thumbnail
content.description: A 44px image cannot explain itself. Keep a meaningful filename or field label nearby so the selected asset remains understandable.
blocks: Pair the cell with the field purpose and a readable filename.
“Identity documents” says more than a generic “Upload.”
Do not use the empty add icon after an asset has been chosen.

inContext.title: Use Additem inside FormUpload
inContext.description: The public composite supplies the field label, support text, attachment row, picker handoff, and controlled attachment list.
specimen: Add a clear image and keep the filename nearby.

doDont.title: Explain what the thumbnail represents
doDont.description: A small preview is evidence of a choice, not a complete label.
blocks: The attachment remains identifiable even when the image is small.

blocks: Read-only source file · exact Additem node unresolved
Empty, preview, picker, disabled, and all-state stories

Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (5 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Additem defaults its inner IconCapsule to Neutral, Low, and S. The exact Figma node remains unverified. The remove control is its own button beside the preview, named “Remove” plus the preview’s label, and a click, a tap, or Enter removes the item without opening the preview.
